findings.clause: Art. 6/7 - Lawful basis & conditions for consent
findings.title: Tracking script loads before consent
findings.description: A tracking/analytics/ad script (Google Analytics, Meta Pixel, etc.) appears to load unconditionally rather than after a consent decision.

fine_exposure.note: Rough triage estimate, not a legal or actuarial calculation.

findings.remediation: Gate the script load behind an explicit consent check (e.g. only call gtag/fbq/init after the user accepts a cookie/consent banner). Log the consent decision with a timestamp.

findings.clause: Art. 17 - Right to erasure
findings.title: No data deletion / DSAR endpoint found
findings.description: No route or handler matching common "delete my data" / "export my data" patterns was found in the API layer.

fine_exposure.note: Rough triage estimate, not a legal or actuarial calculation.

findings.remediation: Add an authenticated endpoint that deletes or anonymizes a user's personal data on request, and a corresponding data-export endpoint. Document the process in your privacy policy.

findings.clause: WCAG 1.3.1 / 3.3.2 - Info and Relationships / Labels or Instructions
findings.title: Form input without associated label
findings.description: An <input> element was found with no nearby <label> and no aria-label/aria-labelledby attribute.

fine_exposure.note: Rough triage estimate, not a legal or actuarial calculation.

findings.remediation: Associate every input with a visible <label for="id"> or an aria-label/aria-labelledby attribute.

findings.clause: Art. 32 - Security of processing
findings.title: Plaintext storage of personal data field
findings.description: A field name suggesting sensitive personal data (email, ssn, dob, passport, national_id) is written to storage/logs without an encryption or hashing call nearby.

fine_exposure.note: Rough triage estimate, not a legal or actuarial calculation.

findings.remediation: Encrypt sensitive fields at rest (application-level or column-level encryption) and ensure they are never written to plaintext logs.

findings.clause: PCI-DSS Req. 3 - Protect stored cardholder data
findings.title: Card number pattern near a database/log write
findings.description: A variable/field named like a card number (card_number, cc_number, pan, credit_card) appears near a database save or logging call. Cards should generally never touch your own storage — use a tokenized processor (Stripe, Braintree, etc.).

fine_exposure.note: Rough triage estimate, not a legal or actuarial calculation.

findings.remediation: Never store or log raw PANs. Use a PCI-compliant tokenized payment processor and only ever handle the returned token / last-4 digits.

findings.clause: PCI-DSS Req. 3.4 / 10 - Logging
findings.title: Card data potentially written to application logs
findings.description: A logging call (console.log, logger.info, print) appears on the same or adjacent line as a card-shaped variable.

fine_exposure.note: Rough triage estimate, not a legal or actuarial calculation.

findings.remediation: Strip or mask card fields before logging. Never log CVV/CVC under any circumstance (it cannot be stored at all per PCI-DSS).

findings.clause: WCAG 1.1.1 - Non-text Content (Level A)
findings.title: Image without alt text
findings.description: An tag was found without an alt attribute.

fine_exposure.note: Rough triage estimate, not a legal or actuarial calculation.

findings.remediation: Add a descriptive alt attribute (alt="") for decorative images, or a meaningful description for informative ones.

findings.clause: COPPA 16 CFR Part 312 - Parental consent requirement
findings.title: Age gate / birthdate collection without parental consent flow
findings.description: Code collects a date-of-birth or age field (common pattern for under-13 detection) with no nearby parental-consent handling, despite the product plausibly targeting or being accessible to children.

fine_exposure.note: Rough triage estimate, not a legal or actuarial calculation.

findings.remediation: If the service is directed at or knowingly collects data from children under 13, implement verifiable parental consent before collecting personal information, per the FTC's COPPA Rule.

findings.clause: WCAG 2.1.1 - Keyboard (Level A)
findings.title: Click handler on non-interactive element without keyboard support
findings.description: An onClick/onclick handler was found on a <div> or <span> with no tabIndex or keyboard event handler nearby.

fine_exposure.note: Rough triage estimate, not a legal or actuarial calculation.

findings.remediation: Use a native <button> instead, or add tabIndex="0", role="button", and an onKeyDown handler for Enter/Space.

findings.clause: LGPD Art. 7 - Requirements for processing personal data
findings.title: Tracking script loads before consent (LGPD basis)
findings.description: A tracking/analytics/ad script loads unconditionally rather than after a consent or other lawful-basis decision, similar to the GDPR consent requirement but under Brazil's LGPD.

fine_exposure.note: Rough triage estimate, not a legal or actuarial calculation.

findings.remediation: Establish and document one of LGPD's ten lawful bases (Art. 7) before processing, and gate non-essential tracking behind a consent decision where consent is the chosen basis.

findings.clause: PIPEDA Principle 4.2 - Identifying Purposes
findings.title: Personal data collected without identified purpose nearby
findings.description: A signup/registration handler collects personal data fields with no nearby reference to a stated purpose or privacy-policy link, which PIPEDA's Fair Information Principles require be identified at or before collection.

fine_exposure.note: Rough triage estimate, not a legal or actuarial calculation.

findings.remediation: State the purpose for collecting each category of personal information at or before collection (e.g. in the form UI or an accompanying privacy notice), per PIPEDA Principle 4.2.
